Catches fire it extinguishes itself, heals 1 HP per second, is immune to vanilla negative effects and immune to sun burning.$(br)Machine-gun volley (25-second cooldown): fires for 1.5s, 20 arrows in total, ignoring invulnerability frames.$(br)Breaker melee (25-second cooldown): a nearby enemy takes one melee hit for five times its attack.
